transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because for the past nine months, my mood has been incredibly high and then suddenly very irritable, constantly shifting back and forth. I also have this overwhelming energy where I just can't sit still and feel like I always need to be doing something.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever had symptoms so severe that they caused significant problems at work or in your relationships, or required hospitalization?
To be honest, I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really thought about whether it has caused those specific problems with my work or relationships, and I've never been hospitalized.
During those high-energy periods, have you ever experienced any delusions, such as feeling like you have special powers or are being watched, or have you heard or seen things that others could not?

Yes, when my energy is really high, I often feel like I have special powers and that people are watching me. I also hear whispering and see things that others can't, but this only ever happens during these high-energy periods.
